title: Categorical Lusztig cycles and weave schobers
summary: We establish the foundations of categorical weave calculus, developing the diagrammatic calculus of weaves and braid varieties within the study of Calabi-Yau triangulated categories and cluster tilting theory. This is achieved by associating a perverse sheaf of triangulated categories to each Demazure weave. A central contribution is the construction and study of the categorical Lusztig cycles and their duals, which we show form simple-minded and silting collections in the category of global sections of such a sheaf of categories.
